blocks.text: These files were migrated from the former `/Users/richardtang/Documents/Proofpress` checkout, which is no longer maintained. They preserve the STALE/CUPMem condition contract, exploratory preregistration, and observed dataset profile. They are planning inputs only: the source data hash, official implementation revision, model, telemetry contract, and held-out split must be reverified before a scored run.

The former two-arm local Codex pilot was intentionally not migrated as an executable runner. It lacks official CUPMem S1/S3 implementation, an information-parity check across all four arms, and per-call provider/cost/fallback telemetry; it may inform harness design but cannot produce Phase 1 evidence.
